claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Otenzepad is a selective M2-preferring muscarinic antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely be weak and non-selective, possibly reflecting cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than muscarinic receptor blockade.
